Exclusive Valentine's Day Car Detailing Specials

Love is in the air, and your car deserves to feel it too! This February, Mikah's Auto Detailing is bringing Valentine's-ready detailing throughout Columbia and Lexington SC. Whether you're planning a romantic date night or surprising your partner with a thoughtful gift, our professional mobile car detailing services will make your vehicle shine with love.

Our Valentine's presentation options run from February 1-28, 2025, on our regular level-system pricing — no gimmicks, just our most popular mobile detailing packages dressed up for the season. Don't wait - Valentine's Day booking fills up quickly in Columbia SC!

Valentine's Day Car Care Tips

Preparing for Your Special Detail

  • Remove personal items from your vehicle interior
  • Note any special stains or concerns for our detailers
  • Ensure easy access to your vehicle location
  • Plan for 2-4 hours depending on package selected

Maintaining Your Valentine's Detail

  • Avoid automatic car washes for at least 2 weeks
  • Use microfiber cloths for quick touch-ups
  • Park in shade when possible to protect wax
  • Schedule regular maintenance every 4-6 weeks

Frequently Asked Questions

How far in advance should I book for Valentine's Day?

We recommend booking 1-2 weeks in advance for Valentine's Day weekend. Earlier booking ensures your preferred time slot and package availability. We accept cash, checks, Zelle, and credit/debit.

Can I surprise my partner with a detail while they're at work?

Absolutely! We coordinate surprise details regularly. Just ensure we have access to the vehicle and contact information for scheduling.

What if weather interferes with my Valentine's appointment?

We monitor weather closely and will contact you to reschedule if conditions aren't suitable for quality detailing work. Your satisfaction is our priority.

Do you offer same-day gift certificates?

Yes! Digital gift certificates can be delivered same-day via email with beautiful Valentine's presentation. Perfect for last-minute gift needs.

Can I customize a Valentine's package?

Certainly! We're happy to create custom packages combining services to meet your specific Valentine's Day needs and budget.
